method: General text model authored original simultaneous whole-body numerical key poses in this session. Local Python serializes authored pose rows, propagates inherited zero/relaxed-arm posture and applies a simple bilateral knee-height trigonometric approximation. No motion template/prior, external inference, training or audio was read. All marker joints retain zero rotation. No endpoint, outside trajectory or boundary velocity is generated; existing program must freeze them.
limits: Not a Cloudflare inference; no provider API token/cost receipt is available for this Codex-session creation.
Sparse Euler poses do not establish continuous-time joint limits, contact, balance, collision, speed or acceleration.
Simple root height approximation is not IK or validated contact; stepping may slide and relevé contact is unvalidated.
Genre summaries express intent, not a style or naturalness score. Three short phrases do not establish arbitrary-genre capability.
revisionPolicy: First raw output immutable; any later corrections must use separate revision-N files.
